messages:
Olivia (PM): Quick sync — need alignment on Adaptive Prefetch launch criteria + cross-team deps. Target canary in ~3w. @kevin @sasha @raj any major blockers?
Kevin (runtime): KV-prefix cache API change required. ETA ~3w to land, then 1 week of perf verification. Also need model-variant fallback in the runtime.
Sasha (eng-infra): Capacity-wise we can prewarm a small pool but need a commit window for reserved slots. Ops/infra headcount limited next sprint.
Raj (security): For customer pilot we need KMS/HSM path and key-rotation logs. Threat model review required. KMS integration estimate 2w.
Maria (product): Acceptance criteria proposal: P95 latency <120ms on canary, <1% error rate, cost target <= $0.40 per 1k tokens. Canary traffic 5-10% with instant rollback.
Olivia (PM): Thanks. Two risk areas: runtime API change AND KMS. If either slips we should consider a reduced feature canary (no persistent customer keys) — thoughts?
Kevin (runtime): Reduced canary OK: we can run stateless prefetch first (no KV persistence). That shaves ~1.5w off path but lower cache hit rates.
Sasha (eng-infra): If we go stateless prefetch we still need burst nodes for traffic spikes. Ops: can do 48-72h reservation windows. Cost impact ~+8%.
Raj (security): Statelss is fine for MVP, but explicitly call out "no customer key storage" in the vendor contract. Need signoff for customer-facing docs.
Olivia (PM): Proposed plan:
- Week 0: land runtime stateless prefetch (owner: Kevin)
- Week 1: infra reserve burst nodes + prewarm playbook (owner: Sasha)
- Week 2: KMS integration + threat review (owner: Raj) — optional for pilot
- Week 3: perf validation + canary rollout (owner: Maria)
Can everyone confirm or propose changes?
Kevin (runtime): Confirm on timeline, will open PRs and perf bench run. Will call out breaking change in release notes.
Sasha (eng-infra): Confirm, I'll book reservations and draft prewarm runbook.
Raj (security): Confirm conditional: full pilot only after KMS complete. Otherwise product can proceed with stateless pilot.
Maria (product): Confirm. I'll update launch doc and customer comms.
deploy-bot: RFC #AP-42 created: https://redwood-internal/rfc/AP-42 — owners noted.
Olivia (PM): Great — I'll consolidate owners and send meeting invite for Monday to lock dates. :thumbsup:
Maria (product): Adding a quick checklist below for clarity:
```
- runtime: stateless prefetch PR merged
- infra: reserve burst nodes
- security: threat model doc + KMS decision
- product: canary config + rollback plan
```
Kevin (runtime): Also adding a perf gate: 10M token run with 95th percentile latency <=120ms.
Sasha (eng-infra): Noted, will provide monitoring hooks.
Olivia (PM): Thanks all — follow-ups in RFC and calendar. If anyone needs to re-prioritize, ping me directly.
Raj (security): Will attach threat model by EOD Thu.
Maria (product): Cool. :rocket:
Olivia (PM): End.
